title: Carry the ls-tree enumeration idiom into its three remaining instruction-text homes (os-dev.md · platform-readings · AGENTS.md §9) — deferred from #13305 by face-holds and the re-wrap funding ban
body:
Filed by the skills lane seat (session `session_01EXxTW8mvPBhoHxmyPZ63de`, PM loop round 3), executing recommendation B from the #13305 dev report's open question 1, plus the rework fallout on PR #13480. Lane self-triaged: `pm:queue` · `domain:skills` · p2.

## What already exists (do not re-do)

#13305 landed the mechanical layer: `.claude/hooks/guard-tree-enum.sh` (+36-case selftest, registered in `.claude/settings.json`, mirrored into objectui) blocks the working-tree-glob + `origin/main`-read signature, and its BLOCK MESSAGE teaches the canonical idiom at the moment of the mistake. objectui `AGENTS.md` carries the incident subsection (no ratchet binds there). The transferable control sentence is in the guard header and block message verbatim.

## What this card carries — the instruction-TEXT homes the idiom could not reach

1. **`.claude/agents/os-dev.md`** — the "origin/main is a shared pointer" clause; this is where derive-don't-recall habits are taught to every dispatched dev. Was OFF-surface for #13305 (face held by #12980, which is itself parked `needs-user-decision` on a ceiling raise 466→471/473).
2. **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`** — the zero-reading discipline page. Was OFF-surface (face held by the SKILL.md serial queue).
3. **root `AGENTS.md` §9 Practices list** — one practice sentence: enumerate from the ref you read (`git ls-tree --name-only origin/main <dir>`), never a working-tree glob feeding per-file `origin/main` reads. PR #13480's first attempt funded this by re-wrapping the surrounding block ~85B→~115B at constant line count — **removed in rework as 筹行** (banned 2026-08-17, sharpened 2026-08-29: 「筹行(为内容购买行数)⛔ vs 独立密度修复(无内容购买)允许」). AGENTS.md is 1162/1162, so this sentence needs legal funding: a ruled ceiling raise (+1), a ruled cut, or riding a future net-content-reduction PR per the ruling's 顺带 clause.

## Why a hook is not enough (from the #13305 report, verified reasoning)

The guard fires only on a Bash PreToolUse command in a repo that registers it. A seat reasoning about enumeration while writing a report, an MCP-only listing, or work in a repo without the hook never meets it. The mechanical guard is the enforcement; the instruction text is where the habit is taught.

## Dispatch constraints (checked at claim time, not now)

- Three faces, three different holders today: os-dev.md ← #12980 (decision box) · platform-readings ← SKILL.md serial tail · AGENTS.md ← #13305 rework, then the #13052 RULED-A raising PR (1162→1164, scope-exact — ⛔ this card's sentence must NOT ride that ruled vehicle).
- Dispatch when the faces are free, or split per face at dispatch time (fold-or-serial answered then). All three files are governed (`.claude/**` / `AGENTS.md`): draft + human merge.
- Line ratchets at claim time to be re-derived, never recalled. The wording should carry the control-sentence cross-reference only if the target file does not already state it.

## Refs

#13305 (parent work, PRs #13480 + objectui#6908) · #12980 (os-dev.md holder + its pending ceiling decision) · #13052 (AGENTS.md §9 sibling raise, RULED A 2026-08-30) · the 2026-08-17 funding ban + 2026-08-29 distinction (SKILL.md 机械守卫索引 row).
